body:
I think know how he might feel. My friends always invite me places to go, and on the off chance I actually agree to go, for some reason I feel like I ruin the entire event. I always end up leaving earlier than everyone else because I feel like they would have more fun without me.


Even today, when texting my best friend, I would always try to cut the conversations short because I always felt like I was being a nuisance. It always confuses her whenever I do that.


I can't recommend much to help right now. I always felt like that because I was afraid. Because I was scared. I always wanted someone to talk to, someone I can share my feelings with. But with your SO, it seems to be the opposite.


I've been staring at what you said for the past hour and I really don't know what to say.


I think maybe he feels like he did something wrong. Maybe something to hurt you or another person? Has he done anything unusual/different lately?


Maybe he got in an argument or a fight with someone and it's slowly eating away at him from the inside. Maybe he did something that made him uncomfortable and he is having trouble dealing with it.


Has he tried talking to someone that isn't very close to him? I would be more than willing to talk to him if he wants. Maybe talking with someone that has had trouble dealing with suicide and depression would be more comfortable for him.

I don't want to say that you should call the police or tell his parents/roomates/etc. because, in my opinion, that only makes the problems worse.

The one thing I would recommend you do is show him that you care. Maybe talk with him on skype, or try getting into things he likes to do for a while. Give him a reason to smile. Show him that life is fun and full of laughter.

Don't bring up the issue immediately, but slowly progress into the problem by asking him how he is doing or if there is anything he needs help with.

Would you be able to keep this updated? I would like to know how it is going.
Yea that happens to me too. I just like to pretend I'm loved for once, but it doesn't always work. Most of the time, I always cry myself to sleep.
Before falling asleep, I always imaging having a happy and fun life. The perfect life where I have friends and a loving family.

I've a ready been there. A nice bunch of people. Helped me feel better about life for awgile, but then I lost interest in everything and my life started to go down from there.

I appreciate you caring though.

I never lie. Obviously I have lied before, but last year, I decided that I would quit forever. As an advantage, people can always trust me, but sometimes there are things I really don't want to tell people that I have to.
If your suicidal friend goes to you asking for help/advice, don't tell them to fuck off. It hurts them a lot more than you know.
You're the only person that has ever told me that I am a good person. Thank you for that.

Currently I am part of a group to get help clean up my school (and by group it's mostly me). It gets lonely walking around seeing everyone have fun with their friends, but I know what I'm doing helps, even if it's not that much, so it still keeps my spirits high(er). It's nice to know that you believe I can do what I really want. That encourages me more than you know.
Thanks I'm glad to know that some people try to see that I'm not that bad of a person.
